Event Logistics & Track Record

What HQ needs to evaluate the property: when and where it happens, who it reaches, and its track record.

Logistics

  • Expo — dates: May 31 – Jun 20, 2027 (source: HLTV.org, per FiReSPORTS brief)
  • Expo — place: Movistar Arena, Buenos Aires (proposed in the brief; official confirmation from FiReSPORTS still pending)
  • Target audience: CS2 esports fans across Argentina and LATAM, Spanish-language streaming audience, PC gaming and hardware enthusiasts
  • Why this timing: first Major ever awarded to Argentina — a one-time novelty window, timed with the CompraGamer retail sell-out campaign around the tournament's close

Event History & Participation Record

  • 24 official Valve-sponsored Counter-Strike Majors played since 2013 — the most recent, IEM Cologne 2026, was the 24th
  • This is the first Major ever hosted in Argentina
  • The most recent LATAM Major was held in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil — widely regarded as one of the most successful editions ever, driven by the crowd's atmosphere
  • No prior AORUS participation record in this specific event, since it has never been held in the region before

The Pinnacle Event of Counter-Strike

Why a Counter-Strike Major Matters

The Major is the highest tier of the Counter-Strike global competitive circuit — the single most valuable sponsorship property in the game.

32 best teams in the world competing for the most prestigious title in Counter-Strike.

Multi-week tournament generating sustained global engagement across every stage.

Historic moments that define esports culture, replayed for years after the event.

Tier 1 sponsorship property with premium, performance-driven brand positioning.

04 — Sales-Driven Campaign

Retail Sell-Out with CompraGamer

The 100 signed collector units — 90 from Setup A and 10 from Setup B (used in the Final) — are sold post-event exclusively through CompraGamer, Argentina's largest gaming e-tailer — turning the Major into a direct retail activation, not just a media moment.

Exclusive Retail Partner

Argentina's #1 gaming-focused e-commerce platform, with the largest established base of PC gaming and hardware buyers in the country — the natural home for a limited, collector-grade AORUS drop.

Exclusive Drop100 signed, numbered AORUS Major collector PCs (90 Setup A + 10 Setup B Final units) — sold only on CompraGamer, nowhere else.
Major-Timed LaunchSale opens around the tournament's closing moment, riding the peak of hype and media coverage.
Frictionless CheckoutCompraGamer's native installment financing ("cuotas sin interés") lowers the barrier for a premium-priced collector item.
Cross-PromotionCompraGamer's newsletter, social channels and homepage placements amplify AORUS and the Major to their full gamer audience.
Bundle UpsellOptional AORUS peripheral bundles (mouse, keyboard, monitor) offered at checkout to lift average order value.
Lead CaptureEvery purchase and waitlist signup feeds a qualified gamer database for future AORUS retargeting in Argentina.

Why CompraGamer

  • Direct access to Argentina's largest concentration of PC gaming buyers, without building retail infrastructure from scratch
  • Established payments, logistics and warranty support de-risk selling a high-value, limited-run collector product
  • Local credibility and trust reduce friction for a premium-priced drop tied to a first-time event in the country
  • Reinforces AORUS's premium positioning by association with the country's leading gaming retail destination
Ties Directly To The Recovery Estimate
The $249,828 estimated recovery in the Investment section (~$2,498 per unit across 100 units) is the resale plan this campaign is built to deliver.

07 — Timeline

Master Schedule — 9 Phases

August 2026 → August 2027. Venue and detailed match schedule (Swiss Stage / Playoffs) were not yet officially confirmed by FiReSPORTS at the time this plan was built — Phases 6–8 dates will adjust once published.

P0

Kickoff & Brief Validation — 01–17 Aug 2026 Date needs internal confirmation

Align the approved brief (14 items) with FiReSPORTS, define KPIs and budget. Owner: Accounts / MKT Direction

P1

Creative Design & Concepts — 20 Aug – 11 Oct 2026

Naming and artwork for totems, signage, daily activation, Road Trip truck, press kit. Owner: Creative / Design

P2

Physical Production & Branding — 14 Oct – 27 Dec 2026

Manufacturing of totems, display PCs, signage, merchandise, truck wrap. Owner: Production / Vendors

P3

Copa Road Trip (Tour) — 01 Jan – 30 May 2027

City route, activations with AORUS PCs, merchandise giveaways, content coverage. Owner: Logistics / Content

P4

Bootcamps & Player Management — 01 Mar – 24 Jun 2027

Bootcamp PCs on site, coordination of the signing of the 100 GPUs with teams/players. Owner: Team Relations / Legal

P5

Broadcast & Content — 01 Apr – 24 Jun 2027

PNT, casters' notebooks, "Replay by AORUS" segment, interview script, content reuse rights. Owner: Content / Broadcast

P6

Arena Pre-Build — 24–30 Jun 2027

Installation of totems and signage at Movistar Arena, technical tests, final checklist. Owner: Production / Logistics

P7

Live Event — Swiss Stage + Playoffs — 30 Jun – 20 Jul 2027

Daily activation and giveaways, live PNT, Replay by AORUS, champion interview and photo, after parties during playoffs. Owner: Full team

P8

Post-Event — 21 Jul – 31 Aug 2027

Metrics report, content reuse, vendor close-out and client wrap-up. Owner: Accounts / Analytics
